description: Header file defining the ImageProcessorWithPool class, which manages image processing with a frame pool in Chrome OS media GPU context.

classes.name: ImageProcessorWithPool
classes.description: Manages image processing with a frame pool, supporting asynchronous processing and frame management.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to initialize and create an instance of ImageProcessorWithPool.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes a video frame and invokes callback upon completion.

methods.name: HasPendingFrames
methods.description: Checks if there are frames pending processing.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Abandons all pending frames and resets the processor state.

methods.name: SupportsIncoherentBufs
methods.description: Checks if the image processor supports incoherent buffers.

methods.name: backend_type
methods.description: Returns the type of backend used by the image processor.
